system.description:
At 2nd level, your ability to empower your cantrips grows. You may add your spellcasting modifier in damage to each target damaged by your cantrips. In addition, cantrips which do not normally deal damage instead increase their area, weight limit, or duration to double their normal value. If a spell cannot be improved in these ways easily, it instead gains a range of 30ft. Your selection is made at the time of casting.

@UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.mocigztrqyoks506]{Mage Hand}, for example, can instead lift up to 20 pounds and lasts for 2 minutes per casting. @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.bqavvq6ju5ti8hr3]{Light} increases its radius to 40ft of bright light and 40ft of dim light for 2 hours. @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.omvngnmoo75is54f]{Spare the Dying} gains a range of 30ft. @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-spells.Item.okqhwebhlb89crxe]{Arcane Muscles} adds your modifier to each unarmed strike.
